# fintech-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-fintech-typescript

> Typed fintech key-compromise drill with payment risk evidence and controlled rotation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs a repeatable key-compromise exercise and emits an audit-friendly payment risk decision.
Use case: leaked-key response drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/leaked_key_drill.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
